subject.title: feat(agents): add iteration budget for agent loop safety

question: Should `maxToolCallingRounds` ship as a built-in-OpenClaw-only setting that rejects plugin harness runs, or should a supported harness capability be designed before exposing the config?
rationale: This is a permanent public configuration and harness-compatibility choice; source review can verify implementation mechanics but cannot decide which runtime contract maintainers intend to support.

options.title: Keep built-in-only fail-closed
options.body: Approve the narrow documented contract, retain immediate rejection for plugin harnesses, and require exact-head upgrade and live proof before merge.

options.title: Add a harness capability first
options.body: Pause the public setting until agent harnesses have an explicit optional enforcement capability and compatibility tests.

recommendation.title: Keep built-in-only fail-closed
